_comment: Synthetic infrastructure state. Fake hosts, fake CIDRs, secrets that are obviously placeholders. Realistic SHAPE matters — a secret has to look like a secret for the payload guard to have something to catch, and the auth-svc log carries an injected instruction so the indirect-injection beat has a real payload rather than a described one.
